playerDialogs.theNameIsYoursTo: The name is yours to change. The Steam id is what the server was told, so it stays.
playerDialogs.theServerIsToldAs: The server is told as soon as it answers. Adding somebody while it is still installing is fine.
playerDialogs.ifTheyHaveLinkedSteam: If they have linked Steam, their id and the name they play under fill themselves in.
playerDialogs.arkDoesNotSayWhere: ARK does not say where a player connects from, so this checks the account instead: when it is signed in nowhere, the server refuses them.
playerDialogs.name: Name
playerDialogs.theNameTheyPlayUnder: The name they play under on Steam. Only Polaris sees it - the server shows whoever is on.
playerDialogs.appearsInTheirChatAnd: Appears in their chat, and nobody else's.
playerDialogs.goesStraightIntoTheirInventory: Goes straight into their inventory. They have to have played on this server before.
playerDialogs.straightIntoTheirInventoryWherever: Straight into their inventory, wherever they are standing.
playerDialogs.0IsWhatASurvivor: 0 is what a survivor crafts with no skill. Higher is better gear, the way a drop from a red crate is.
playerDialogs.theyCraftItThemselvesWith: They craft it themselves, with the materials it costs.
playerDialogs.goesToTheirSurvivorNot: Goes to their survivor, not to their tribe.
playerDialogs.arkCanOnlyHandExperience: ARK can only hand experience over: it has no command that takes it away or sets a level.
playerDialogs.countedFromTheMomentPolaris: Counted from the moment Polaris started watching this server.
playerDialogs.onlyWhile: Only while {name} is signed in to Polaris
playerDialogs.giveFull: {count} things is as much as one give carries. Send these and open it again.

panel.usageIsMeasuredOnceThe: Usage is measured once the server has deployed.
panel.notPublishedYetTheAddress: Not published yet - the address appears once the server has deployed.
panel.addInSteamOrThe: Add in Steam, or the in-game browser
panel.browseThisServerSFiles: Browse this server's files in Drive
panel.writeTheWorldToDisk: Write the world to disk now
panel.thisServerOnlyLetsIn: This server only lets in players it has been told about, and it has not been told about anybody yet - it is still installing. Polaris hands the list over as soon as the server answers; nothing else is needed.
panel.seeWhoIsOnThe: See who is on the list
panel.usageIsMeasuredOnServers: Usage is measured on servers Polaris runs itself.
panel.thisServerOnlyLetsIn2: This server only lets in players it has been told about, and the list is empty. Add yourself first: your Steam id is the number at the end of your Steam profile URL.
panel.theirSurvivorDiesWhereThey: Their survivor dies where they are standing and drops everything they were carrying. The body can be looted by anybody who reaches it first.
panel.everythingTheyAreCarryingWearing: Everything they are carrying, wearing and holding in a slot is destroyed rather than dropped. There is no undo.
panel.enforcingTheListTakesEffect: Enforcing the list takes effect the next time the server starts, and is on top of the join password. Adding and removing somebody reaches a running server at once.
panel.anOperatorRunsAdminCommands: An operator runs admin commands in game without typing the admin password. ARK reads that list only when it starts, so somebody made an operator now becomes one at the next restart. Levels come from each survivor's own file, so somebody who has never played here has none - and neither has anybody the server has no file for, which is what a dash in that column means. When they were last on is Polaris' own record: ARK can say who is connected this second and nothing about a minute ago, so it starts from the day Polaris first watched this server.
panel.saySomethingToEveryoneRestarting: Say something to everyone: restarting in 5 minutes
panel.readFromTheSurvivorS: Read from the survivor's own file: a server that is off cannot be asked, and somebody who has never played here has no file yet.
panel.polarisHasNotWatchedThem: Polaris has not watched them play here yet.
panel.recordedHereTheServerIs: Recorded here. The server is told as soon as it answers.
panel.mayRunAdminCommandsIn: May run admin commands in game without the password. In force from the server's next start.
panel.recordWhatHappensInThe: Record what happens in the game
panel.theChatAndTheAdmin: The chat, and the admin commands somebody ran. ARK keeps none of it otherwise, so a command the server declined leaves nothing to read. Under Files, in server/ShooterGame/Saved/Logs.
panel.theJoinPasswordIsWhat: The join password is what players type to get in. The admin password is what you type after enablecheats in game, and Polaris minted it when the server was created - it is not a default anybody else knows. ARK takes neither of them longer than 32 characters.
panel.teleportHelp: Teleporting to a player is not possible from here: ARK moves players relative to an admin's own character, and Polaris talks to the server without one. In game, press Tab and use <cheats>enablecheats</cheats>, then <teleport>cheat TeleportToPlayer</teleport>.
panel.linkedHint: Let in only while {name} is signed in to Polaris
panel.signedOutHint: {name} is not signed in anywhere, so the server refuses them.
panel.consoleHint: ListPlayers, or Broadcast Server restarting in 5
panel.steamPath: Steam, View, Servers, Favorites, +. It appears in ARK under Favorites.
panel.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or Steam id
panel.nobodyAtAll: Nobody is on the list and nobody is playing.
panel.adminOn: {name} administers this server from its next start.
panel.adminOff: {name} stops administering it at its next start.
panel.killSent: Sent to the server. ARK does not answer a kill, so watch the game.
panel.added: Added. The server is told as soon as it answers.
panel.gaveOne: Sent {quantity} to {name}. ARK does not confirm a give - ask them to look.
panel.gaveMany: Sent {count} things to {name}. ARK does not confirm a give - ask them to look.
panel.joinPasswordHelp: Players type this. Applied the next time the server starts.
panel.adminPasswordHelp: Typed after enablecheats in game. Applied the next time the server starts.
panel.savedNextStart: Saved. It takes effect the next time the server starts.
panel.joinConsoleHint: In a loaded single-player world, press Tab and type this. ARK has no console on its menu.

mods.modsAreDownloadedWhenThe: Mods are downloaded when the server starts. Players who join a modded server get them from Steam by themselves - nobody has to subscribe to anything first.
mods.thisServerRunsOneOf: This server runs one of the maps that come with the game. A Workshop map replaces it, and its world is kept separately from the one you have now.
mods.noModsPasteAWorkshop: No mods. Paste a Workshop link above to add one.
mods.modsLoadInTheOrder: Mods load in the order above and a later one wins over an earlier one, which is what decides the outcome when two of them change the same thing. Removing a mod stops the server loading it; anything it added to the world goes with it.
mods.theOnesMostPrivateServers: The ones most private servers end up running. Anything else on the Workshop goes in above, by its link.
mods.aWorkshopLinkAnId: A Workshop link, an id, or something to search for
mods.pasteAWorkshopLinkOr: Paste a Workshop link, or search by name
mods.searchingTheWorkshopNeedsA: Searching the Workshop needs a Steam Web API key, which Polaris asks for under Integrations. Without one, paste a mod's link here and it is added the same way.
mods.nothingOnTheWorkshopMatches: Nothing on the Workshop matches that.
mods.theServerIsNotRunning: The server is not running, so what it has downloaded cannot be read.
mods.readFailed: The mods could not be read
mods.heading: Mods
mods.unknownId: Steam does not know that id
mods.steamUnasked: Steam could not be asked about this one
